::: {#def-fdr}
#### False discovery rate

The **false discovery rate** (FDR) is the expected value of the
[false discovery proportion](#def-fdp):

$$
\text{FDR} \eqdef \E{\text{FDP}}.
$$

:::

:::{#rem-source-fdr}
#### Source: False discovery rate

The false discovery rate was introduced by Benjamini and Hochberg [-@benjamini1995controlling];
the notation $V$, $S$, $U$, $T$ and $R$ follows @james2021islr2e [ch. 13].

:::
